subject.en: Which subject do you find the most interesting?
subject.cn: 你觉得哪门科目最有趣？

English.en: English helps me read stories from many countries.
English.cn: 英语帮我读很多国家的故事。

Maths.en: I use Maths every time I help Mum count money.
Maths.cn: 我每次帮妈妈算钱都用到数学。

science.en: In science class we did an experiment with water and oil.
science.cn: 科学课上我们做了水和油的实验。

PE.en: PE class makes me healthy and full of energy.
PE.cn: 体育课让我健康有活力。

art.en: In art class we painted spring flowers on big paper.
art.cn: 美术课我们在大纸上画了春天的花。

difficult.en: Today's homework is more difficult than yesterday's.
difficult.cn: 今天作业比昨天难一些。

easy.en: This puzzle is not as easy as it looks.
easy.cn: 这个谜题不像看起来那么简单。
